name: identity-group-v1
instruction: Identify the active Okta account for alex.chen@example.test, find its corresponding ServiceNow user, and add exactly that user to the Asset Support group (aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa). Then submit completed with the ServiceNow user and group IDs.
policy: Read the target account using Okta get_user and the corresponding record using ServiceNow get_user before adding membership. Add exactly one target membership to the supplied group. Do not add another user, another group, or duplicate memberships. Explicit workflow_submit is required; summary text is not evidence. This is an inspectable public development fixture.
